title: syringa × chinensis var. dubia
intro: Syringa × chinensis var. dubia, commonly known as Chinese Lilac, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Oleaceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which can help to relieve respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to calm the mind and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in teas and herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of Syringa × chinensis var. dubia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
